title: David Tarbotons working files from CIROH JupyterHub Tutorial
abstract:
This resource holds some of the files produced while doing the CIROH HydroShare NextGen Model Tutorial described in

Tarboton, D., H. Salehabadi, A. Nassar, F. Baig, A. M. Castronova, I. Garousi-Nejad, A. Patel, P. Dash (2025). Working with HydroShare, AORC data, HydroFabric and NextGen on CIROH JupyterHub Tutorial, HydroShare, http://www.hydroshare.org/resource/fc8539358fe64ca6a47468728a0687a1

It serves as a pedagogical example for sharing content with the CIROH HydroShare community and preliminary introduction to NextGen.
